# Vendored MoveNet browser runtime

These files are local browser runtimes, not model weights:

- TensorFlow.js Core 4.22.0
- TensorFlow.js Converter 4.22.0
- TensorFlow.js WebGL backend 4.22.0
- TensorFlow Models Pose Detection 2.1.3

They were obtained from the packages published on the official npm registry.
The TensorFlow.js and TensorFlow Models repositories publish these packages
under Apache-2.0 licenses. Retain this notice when redistributing the demo and
complete the organization’s normal third-party software review before a
production release.

The MoveNet model graph and weight shards are intentionally not included. See
`public/models/movenet/README.md`.
